subject: Incident-scoped log redaction plan and evidence timeline
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@fastbank.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-10T08:42:00Z
Subject: Production latency spike — immediate telemetry & chain-of-custody request

Irene / Marissa —

We observed a ~6x latency increase on FastBank’s production integration between 07:55–08:15 PST this morning, with a corresponding rise in 5xx errors for a subset of requests (tenant: FASTBANK-PROD). Our security & compliance team is requesting the following as part of an incident evidence packet:

- Scoped logs (request/response headers, request ids, tenant ids) for 07:30–09:00 PST
- Any aggregated telemetry (p90/p99 latency, error-rate by route) covering the same window
- Details on retention policy and whether those records have been preserved or rotated
- A proposed plan for production log redaction (PII minimization) before handover to our auditors
- Chain-of-custody and who will have access to delivered artifacts (names + roles)

We need a timeframe for when you can provide the scoped artifacts and an indication whether you can host the bundle in a secure, time-limited location for our audit team. Our external auditors may request temporary, read-only access.

Attaching a screenshot from our side showing the spike. Please treat this as high priority — legal is monitoring this.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Ops Manager, FastBank
elena@fastbank.com
(attachment: screenshot_latency_2026-12-10.png)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-10T09:01:00Z
Subject: Re: Production latency spike — immediate telemetry & chain-of-custody request

Marissa / Sean —

Looping you in: FastBank just reported a targeted latency + 5xx spike for tenant FASTBANK-PROD (07:55–08:15 PST). Initial notes from infra: there was an autoscaler bounce in us-west-2 at ~07:50 that correlated with increased queuing on model workers; we need to confirm if that produced partial request drops or retried requests.

Quick checklist I propose we confirm within the hour so we can reply to Elena with a concrete plan:

- Preservation: Create an immutable snapshot of the telemetry window (07:30–09:00 PST). Do not rotate or truncate logs for that tenant.
- Scope: Pull request-level logs, route-level latency aggregations, and runtime traces where available. Exclude full model IO (customer content) unless explicitly requested in writing.
- Redaction: Produce a redaction scope doc (minimal PII policy) that we can run against the bundle prior to handing to FastBank auditors. Priya, can Legal confirm required redaction baseline?
- Access: Prepare a secure transfer mechanism (expiring GCS signed url or sftp with time-limited creds). We should capture access audit logs and include them in the manifest.
- Chain-of-custody: Record who performs the data export, hashes of delivered artifacts, and timestamps.

Sean — can infra create the snapshot and list the exact artifact paths? Marissa — can you coordinate with Solutions/CS to confirm exactly what the audit team will accept (scoped CSV vs complete bundle)? Priya — please advise on redaction minimums and any additional approvals needed.

We should aim to give FastBank an ETA for secure delivery within 3 business days unless infra can provide sooner. I will draft a short reply to Elena once we confirm scope/timeline.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@fastbank.com>, Audit Team <audit@fastbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-10T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Production latency spike — incident-scoped artifacts & next steps

Elena —

Thank you for the heads up and the screenshot. We’ve initiated an incident preservation workflow and below is our plan and deliverables. If this looks acceptable, we’ll proceed immediately.

What we will preserve and deliver (scoped to 07:30–09:00 PST, FASTBANK-PROD):

- Request-level logs: request_id, route, timestamps, response_status, latency_ms, tenant_id (no full request/response bodies)
- Aggregated telemetry: p50/p90/p99 latency and error-rate by route and host
- Runtime traces where available (service spans only; no model output payloads)
- Evidence manifest: file list + SHA256 hashes + generation timestamps

Redaction approach:

- We will not include model-generated content or full request/response bodies unless FastBank’s legal provides written consent specifying what is required.
- We will remove any fields flagged as PII per the attached redaction_scope.md (standard baseline: user identifiers hashed, email addresses redacted, account numbers masked).

Chain-of-custody & access:

- Artifacts will be staged to a time-limited, access-audited GCS bucket. We will record exporter identity, export timestamps, and artifact checksums as part of the evidence manifest.
- Access will be granted as read-only to named audit emails for a 7-day window unless you request a different window.

ETA and next steps:

- Infra (Sean) will generate the preservation snapshot and manifest within 6 hours and provide artifact paths.
- Marissa will confirm acceptable artifact formats for your auditors by EOD.
- Priya (Legal) will confirm the redaction baseline; if additional fields are required by your auditors, please send a written list.
- We expect to share a secure link for initial review within 24–36 hours, and a full downloadable evidence bundle within 72 hours, assuming no additional redaction iterations.

Attachments: evidence_manifest.csv (placeholder), redaction_scope.md (redaction baseline).

Please confirm: do your auditors want direct access to the GCS staging location (read-only) or would you prefer we deliver a zipped bundle to an SFTP endpoint? Also please provide the canonical audit contact emails so we can add them to the access grant.

I’ll keep you posted as we progress.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
(attachments: evidence_manifest.csv, redaction_scope.md)
